definitions.explanation: Describes a continuous rotating or circular motion, or something wrapped around repeatedly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐるぐる⟦{回|まわ}って→回る：01150_mawaru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My head is spinning. (lit. My eyes are spinning.)

examples.japanese: ⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぐるぐる⟦{巻|ま}いた→巻く：02418_maku⟧。
examples.english: I wound the rope round and round.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{尻尾|しっぽ}→尻尾：09089_shippo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぐるぐる⟦{振|ふ}って→振る：01983_furu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The dog is wagging its tail in circles.

notes:
ぐるぐる is a ⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧ (mimetic word) that describes continuous circular or rotating motion. It conveys a sense of repeated, often vigorous spinning or winding.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ぐるぐる⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to spin around and around
- ぐるぐる⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧: to wrap around repeatedly
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐるぐる⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feel dizzy
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐるぐる⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: eyes spinning (dizzy)
- ぐるぐる⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to turn something round and round

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦くるくる→くるくる：05352_kurukuru⟧: spinning, whirling (lighter, more nimble motion)
- ⟦ぐらぐら→ぐらぐら：16211_guragura⟧: wobbling, shaking unsteadily
- ⟦ぐるっと→ぐるっと：noentry⟧: going around once (single circuit)

USAGE:
The reduplicated form emphasizes continuous repetition. The single form ⟦ぐるっと→ぐるっと：noentry⟧ describes one complete rotation or circuit: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぐるっと⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around the park once).
